issue_context.title: Supports transitions between the same type (String types)
issue_context.body:
### Description

Supports transitions between the same types, including unsigned transitions.

### Value

- Support conversion between String types
    + The CHAR and VARCHAR Types
    + The BINARY and VARBINARY Types
    + The BLOB and TEXT Types
    + The ENUM Type
    + The SET Type
